Tile a transcript file (punkst pts2tiles)

Source: R/stages.R
punkst_pts2tiles.Rd

Splits a delimited point file into spatial tiles and writes an index. Covers the standard mode of punkst pts2tiles; the --tile-op-factor-tsv mode (converting factor-probability output, with --binary-out, --K, --pixel-res, --feature-dict) is not wrapped. Defaults are punkst's own, and an option is passed only when it differs from its default, except that the column indices default to 0, 1 and 2 (x, y, feature), the layout written by sdata_export(), where punkst has no default.

Usage

punkst_pts2tiles(
  tsv,
  workdir,
  tile_size,
  icol_x = 0L,
  icol_y = 1L,
  icol_feature = 2L,
  icol_z = NULL,
  icol_int = NULL,
  csv = FALSE,
  keep_quotes = NULL,
  skip = 0L,
  skip_last_is_header = FALSE,
  scale = 1,
  scale_x = NULL,
  scale_y = NULL,
  scale_z = NULL,
  digits = 2L,
  include_cols = NULL,
  exclude_cols = NULL,
  tile_buffer = 1000L,
  batch_size = 10000L,
  temp_dir = NULL,
  threads = 1L,
  verbose = 1000000L,
  debug = 0L,
  bin = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

tsv

Input delimited file (--in-tsv), e.g. from sdata_export().

workdir

Directory for outputs, logs and the manifest.

tile_size

Tile size in the input's coordinate units (--tile-size). Required.

icol_x, icol_y, icol_feature

0-based columns of x, y and feature (--icol-x, --icol-y, --icol-feature). icol_feature = NULL omits the feature column and the feature dictionary output.

icol_z

Optional 0-based z column (--icol-z).

icol_int

Optional 0-based integer-value (count) columns (--icol-int).

csv

Treat the input as CSV (--csv); punkst otherwise infers it from the file extension.

keep_quotes

0-based columns to keep quoted in CSV output (--keep-quotes).

skip

Number of input lines to skip (--skip).

skip_last_is_header

Treat the last skipped line as the header (--skip-last-is-header). Lines starting with # at the top are detected automatically, so this is not needed for sdata_export() output.

scale

Uniform coordinate scale factor (--scale).

scale_x, scale_y, scale_z

Per-axis scale factors that override scale (--scale-x, --scale-y, --scale-z).

digits

Precision of rewritten coordinates when scaling is applied (--digits).

include_cols, exclude_cols

0-based columns to keep or drop in the tiled output (--include-cols, --exclude-cols; mutually exclusive). The column positions in the tiled file then differ from the input, so pass matching icol_* to punkst_tiles2hex().

tile_buffer

Buffer lines per tile per thread (--tile-buffer).

batch_size

Batch size in lines for gzipped or streamed input (--batch-size).

temp_dir

Directory for temporary files (--temp-dir); default is <workdir>/tmp_pts2tiles.

threads

Number of threads (--threads).

verbose, debug

Verbosity and debug level (--verbose, --debug).

bin

Path to punkst; see punkst_setup().

overwrite

Re-run even if up to date.

Value

A punkstTiles stage object with the output files (tsv, index, coord_range, and features when a feature column is given).

Examples

# Requires the 'punkst' binary (see check_punkst_setup()); skipped otherwise.
tsv <- tempfile(fileext = ".tsv")
writeLines(c("1\t1\tA0", "2\t2\tB0"), tsv)
tryCatch(
    punkst_pts2tiles(tsv, tempfile(), tile_size = 500),
    error = function(e) message("punkst not available: ", conditionMessage(e)))
#> [punkstR] pts2tiles: running
#> [punkstR] pts2tiles: done in 0 s
#> <punkstTiles> in /tmp/RtmpNiRhoD/file1a6e5e123778
#>   tsv       /tmp/RtmpNiRhoD/file1a6e5e123778/tiled.tsv
#>   index     /tmp/RtmpNiRhoD/file1a6e5e123778/tiled.index
#>   coord_range /tmp/RtmpNiRhoD/file1a6e5e123778/tiled.coord_range.tsv
#>   features  /tmp/RtmpNiRhoD/file1a6e5e123778/tiled.features.tsv
